posts.author: HuangLongGaming
posts.body:
is there any scripts available for VXAce that allow you to modify the crit rate of specific skills or something that achieves that effect like adding a state to the user that boosts crit rate before the attack goes off? I've been trying to wrap my head around VXAce skill crit rates for ages, it's baffling that it isn't a default feature in all rpg maker engines. here's what I'm trying to get:
Cleaver: Single target weak Slash dmg, 15% crit rate

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Victor has a Critical Hit Effects script for VX Ace that might do what you want. You'll probably find others with google.
